toc.title: Integration: the cloud block and login

html:
1What HCP Terraform is

HCP Terraform is HashiCorp's managed service for running Terraform in a team. It adds remote state, remote runs, collaboration and governance to the Community edition of Terraform. (Terraform Enterprise is the self-hosted version.)

Capability Meaning
Remote state Stored, versioned, encrypted and locked by the service
Remote operations Plan and apply run on HCP Terraform, not on your laptop
Collaboration Shared workspaces, run history, comments, teams
Governance Policy enforcement, cost estimation, private registry, access control
Security Sensitive variables, dynamic credentials

2Organizations, projects and workspaces

Level Meaning
Organization The top level of an account: teams, settings and billing
Project A group of workspaces (for example per team or product); permissions and variable sets can be applied to a project
Workspace One unit of infrastructure: its own configuration, state, variables, run history and permissions

HCP Terraform workspaces differ from CLI workspaces. A CLI workspace is another state file in the same working directory and backend. An HCP Terraform workspace is a full environment with its own variables, permissions and runs.

Exam tip

. Organization → project → workspace. A workspace holds state, variables and runs. Projects organize workspaces and share access rules.

3Workflows to create infrastructure

Workflow How runs start
Version control (VCS)-driven Connect a repository; a commit or merge starts a run; pull requests start speculative plans
CLI-driven Use the terraform CLI locally; plan and apply run remotely in a workspace
API-driven Call the HCP Terraform API from other tools (for example a pipeline)

A run has stages: plan, optional policy checks and cost estimate, then apply (after approval, or automatically if auto-apply is on). A speculative plan only shows changes and cannot be applied.

4Integration: the cloud block and login

terraform {
  cloud {
    organization = "example-org"

    workspaces {
      name = "app-prod"
    }
  }
}
Step Command or setting
Authenticate terraform login stores an API token on your machine
Connect The cloud block names the organization and workspace (or tags or a project)
Initialize terraform init; it can migrate existing local state into the workspace
Run terraform plan and terraform apply run remotely and stream the output to your terminal
Execution mode Remote (on HCP Terraform), local (on your machine, state in HCP Terraform) or agent (your own runners)
Exam tip

. terraform login gets the token; the cloud block selects the workspace. A remote run still prints its output in your terminal.

5Collaboration and governance features

Feature What it does
Teams and permissions Role-based access to organizations, projects and workspaces (read, plan, write, admin)
Variable sets Reusable sets of variables applied to many workspaces or projects; sensitive values are write-only
Run triggers Start a run in one workspace when another applies successfully
Policy enforcement Sentinel or Open Policy Agent (OPA) policies check every run; levels such as advisory and mandatory
Cost estimation Estimates the monthly cost of a plan
Private registry Your own private modules and providers
Drift detection Health assessments that check regularly for drift and run checks
Dynamic provider credentials Short-lived credentials through workload identity, instead of stored keys
Explorer and change requests See and track workspaces and their health across the organization
Exam tip

. Variable sets share variables, run triggers chain workspaces, policies (Sentinel or OPA) enforce rules, the private registry shares modules.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A team wants plan and apply to run on a managed service and the state to be stored and locked there. What should it use?

  • AA local backend with a shared disk
  • BA Git repository for the state file
  • CA module from the public registry
  • DHCP Terraform
Show the answer

Answer: D. HCP Terraform provides remote operations, and stores, versions and locks the state.

S2What is a project in HCP Terraform?

  • AA copy of the state file of a workspace
  • BA saved plan of a run
  • CA group of workspaces with shared access settings
  • DA provider plugin for the organization
Show the answer

Answer: C. Projects organize workspaces and let teams apply permissions and variable sets to many of them.

S3Which command stores an API token so the CLI can talk to HCP Terraform?

  • Aterraform init -token
  • Bterraform login
  • Cterraform output
  • Dterraform cloud
Show the answer

Answer: B. terraform login obtains and stores the API token used to authenticate.

S4Which block connects a configuration to an HCP Terraform workspace?

  • AThe cloud block
  • BThe backend block with the local type
  • CThe provider block
  • DThe module block
Show the answer

Answer: A. The cloud block names the organization and workspace.

S5An organization wants to apply the same set of cloud credentials variables to many workspaces. What should it use?

  • AA local value
  • BA variable set
  • CAn output value
  • DA run trigger
Show the answer

Answer: B. Variable sets are reusable groups of variables applied to many workspaces or projects.

S6Which feature starts a run in a second workspace after the first workspace applies successfully?

  • AA run trigger
  • BA policy set
  • CA speculative plan
  • DA private registry
Show the answer

Answer: A. Run triggers chain workspaces so that one run starts after another succeeds.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What does a workspace hold in HCP Terraform?

Show the answer

Configuration, state, variables, run history and permissions.

R2What groups workspaces?

Show the answer

A project.

R3Which command authenticates the CLI?

Show the answer

terraform login.

R4Name two policy frameworks.

Show the answer

Sentinel and Open Policy Agent.

R5What is a speculative plan?

Show the answer

A plan that shows changes and cannot be applied.

R6What is Terraform Enterprise?

Show the answer

The self-hosted version of HCP Terraform.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
HCP Terraform managed service: remote state, remote runs, collaboration, governance
Hierarchy organization, project, workspace (state, variables, runs)
Workflows VCS-driven, CLI-driven, API-driven
Integration cloud block, terraform login, init migrates state, remote execution
Features teams, variable sets, run triggers, Sentinel and OPA, cost estimation, private registry, drift detection, dynamic credentials
